summary: Post-refactor regression sweep after backend split (server.py -> core.py + routers/*) and Messages.jsx sub-component extraction. Wrote focused regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression.py: 18/18 PASS covering all route groups called out in the review: auth (4 seed logins + register + disabled 403), users/friends/dms/presence/profile/notes (explicit /friends and /dms 200 verification - is_online move to core.py OK), messaging (workspace/channel/message/react/thread-reply/unreads) + WebSocket realtime (path /api/ws/{channel_id}?token= receives message over live socket), projects+kanban with 403 membership gate, assets upload/list/download, integrations catalog=8/custom-basic connect+test+admin-list+masked config, AI streaming chat, activity/me, admin users/monitoring. Frontend smoke: alice login -> /dashboard -> /messages (MessageParts loads, workspaces+channels render, message composer visible) -> /integrations (loads clean). No console errors, no pageerrors. Backend imports clean, 88 total routes (83 API + others).
action_items: (cleanup, non-blocking) DB accumulated many TEST_ws / TEST_ws_ws workspaces from prior iteration runs and are visible in Alice's Messages sidebar. Add a script or admin cleanup route to purge TEST_* seed data.

(stale tests from iterations <=12) The following pre-existing tests are stale vs. current API and continue to fail; they are NOT refactor regressions but should either be updated or removed to keep CI green: (a) tests/backend_test.py::TestIntegrations::test_catalog expects legacy 'cloud_storage' type (renamed to aws_s3/dropbox/google_drive in iter 12+); (b) tests/test_encryption_activity_admin.py::TestIntegrationCatalog::test_catalog_six and tests/test_threads_mentions_integrations.py::TestIntegrationsCatalog::test_catalog_has_six_types both still expect 6 connectors and 'fields' key, but catalog now has 8 connectors and uses 'methods' for multi-auth connectors; (c) tests/test_avatar_kanban.py::test_delete_project_cascades_tasks expects GET /projects/{deleted}/tasks -> [] but current API correctly returns 404 after project delete; (d) tests/test_connection_methods.py collection fails because it doesn't load /app/backend/.env (needs load_dotenv or export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL); passed 11/12 when env exported.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: server.py is now ~thin bootstrap keeping only /api/ws/{channel_id} + startup/shutdown; core.py holds shared deps (db, get_current_user, require_admin, encrypt/decrypt_config, ws_manager, is_online, PRESENCE_WINDOW, _create_message, _notify_mentions); models.py holds all Pydantic; routers/ split by concern. All 88 routes preserved. is_online move to core.py successfully fixed the /friends NameError (verified 200).

models.py::UserAdminUpdate only allows role + is_active - the previous /admin/users/{id}/disable and /reinstate POST endpoints don't exist as separate paths; disable is done via PUT /admin/users/{id} {is_active:false}. This works but the review request referred to 'disable/reinstate' which are actions on the general update endpoint - consider adding convenience wrappers or documenting.

There is no /messages/{id}/thread GET endpoint - thread replies use POST /messages with parent_id (correct), but there's no dedicated fetch endpoint; the ThreadPanel UI presumably filters client-side. Not a regression from the refactor - pre-existing.

test_connection_methods.py uses `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete` which will fail on Python 3.12+ (deprecated in 3.10, removed later). Should be `asyncio.new_event_loop().run_until_complete`.
Router file names hint at ~200-300 lines each which is a good split - well under the 700-line threshold. server.py is now trivially small (verified via imports).
